def score(A, y):
    (U, s, V) = np.linalg.svd(A, full_matrices=False)
    use = s > s[0] * 1e-09
    U = U[:, use]
    beta = V[use].T @ (U.T @ y / s[use])
    res = A @ beta - y
    loo = res / np.maximum(1 - (U * U).sum(1), 1e-06)
    return (np.sqrt(np.mean(loo ** 2)), np.max(abs(loo)), np.sqrt(np.mean(res ** 2)), beta)
